meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents... “LunaSea,” a beautiful luxury home in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Just a breezy bike ride from the iconic Seaside, this inviting retreat offers the perfect setting for your next 30A getaway. Unwind on the spacious screened porch, explore the surrounding communities with 4 included bikes and enjoy thoughtfully designed living spaces that comfortably accommodate up to 8 guests. With beautiful interiors, inviting outdoor spaces and a fantastic location near some of 30A's favorite restaurants and shops, LunaSea is ready to welcome you. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Seagrove Beach Location: Conveniently located near Seaside's charming boutiques, restaurants and local attractions.Screened Porch with TV: Comfortable outdoor seating, dining space and a cozy porch swing bed.Beautiful Coastal Interiors: Thoughtfully designed living spaces with modern finishes and inviting furnishings.4 Bikes Included: Explore Seagrove Beach, Seaside and neighboring communities along Scenic Highway 30A.3 Bedrooms & 3 Bathrooms: Comfortable accommodations for up to 8 guests across two levels.Open-Concept Living: Spacious gathering areas with comfortable furnishings and plenty of natural light.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "LunaSea is the ultimate beach escape! Just minutes from Seaside, the house completely exceeded our expectations with its charm and comfort!" – Madison H.⭐ "The screened porch was an absolute dream—our go-to spot for relaxing! We loved the perfect location, the stylish décor, and the convenience of the bikes!" – Colin O.⭐ "A stunning home in an unbeatable location, perfect for a family getaway. Everything was flawless—can’t wait to return for another stay!" – Daisy D.*** LIVING AREA ***Step inside LunaSea and discover beautifully designed living spaces made for relaxing and spending time together. The open-concept main living area features comfortable furnishings and plenty of natural light, while the screened-in back porch offers an inviting extension of the home. Whether you're gathering for a movie night, enjoying your morning coffee outdoors or settling into the porch swing bed with a good book, there's a comfortable spot for everyone.Enjoy a bright, open-concept living room with comfortable seating and a large Smart TV for relaxing evenings together.Settle into the cozy sofa, comfortable chairs or porch swing bed on the spacious screened-in porch.Catch your favorite shows or enjoy a movie night on the screened porch's flat-screen TV.*** KITCHEN & DINING ***LunaSea's beautifully appointed kitchen makes preparing meals and gathering around the table easy. With sleek stainless steel appliances, a spacious island and an open layout connecting the kitchen to the main living area, there's plenty of room for cooking and enjoying time together. Start the morning with breakfast at the island, gather around the dining table for dinner or enjoy a meal outside on the screened porch.Prepare your favorite meals in a beautifully appointed kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and an open-concept layout.Enjoy casual breakfasts or morning coffee at the spacious kitchen island with seating for 3.Gather around the dining table with seating for 6, perfect for family dinners and meals together.Take your meals outside and enjoy dining on the screened porch, surrounded by the fresh coastal air.*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Surrounded by the beautiful live oaks of Seagrove Beach, LunaSea's backyard offers a peaceful setting for spending time outdoors. The spacious screened porch is a favorite gathering spot, with comfortable seating, a porch swing bed and a flat-screen TV. Spend the afternoon relaxing in the shade, prepare dinner on the gas grill or enjoy a quiet evening surrounded by the natural beauty of the neighborhood.Spend your afternoons relaxing on comfortable outdoor furnishings, including a cozy porch swing bed, while enjoying your favorite shows on the large TV.Gather for a meal on the screened porch, offering a comfortable setting for dining outdoors.Fire up the gas grill for an easy family dinner or a casual evening cookout.Enjoy the peaceful surroundings of the backyard, framed by Seagrove Beach's beautiful live oak trees.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With three bedrooms and three full bathrooms across two levels, LunaSea comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests. The first-floor bunk room is a great option for children or younger guests, while the upstairs Primary Suite and Queen Guest Bedroom offer comfortable accommodations with private bathrooms. Each space is thoughtfully arranged to provide a relaxing place to recharge after a day exploring 30A.1st Floor:Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin bunk beds and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity, walk-in shower and conveniently located off the living & kitchen areas2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-suite with dual vanities & walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity & shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, LunaSea makes it easy to explore the charming communities and local favorites along Scenic Highway 30A. Hop on one of the 4 included bikes and head toward Seaside, where you'll find boutique shopping, local art and plenty of wonderful places to eat. From dining at nearby favorites like Café Thirty-A and Surfing Deer to exploring the scenic trails at Grayton Beach State Park, there's no shortage of ways to enjoy your stay.Explore Seaside Town Center, where you'll find charming boutiques, local art galleries and wonderful restaurants.Discover the beautiful natural surroundings and scenic trails at Grayton Beach State Park.Enjoy dinner at Café Thirty-A or Surfing Deer, two popular Seagrove Beach restaurants.Hop on one of the 4 included bikes and spend the afternoon exploring the shops, restaurants and neighboring communities along Scenic Highway 30A.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low-Speed Vehicle) is NOT allowed in Rosemary, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active camera located outside of the home by the second-floor window.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we are committed to delivering a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and a professionally maintained home designed for connection, relaxation, and unforgettable beachside memories.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
